composition.story: A sentence is split into tokens. Each token becomes an ID, and the ID picks one row from a learned table E. The word "the" appears twice and gets the same row both times. Adding a position vector P[i] separates them: x_i = E[id_i] + P[i]. Turn positions off and the two vectors become identical again.

aha.observation: Both copies of 'the' copy the same row E[5]. Only the added position vector separates x₀ from x₄, by a distance of 1.82.
